period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (as published in UCB's own annual report's 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financial Statements by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure, not a discrete-quarter figure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK. Cross-validated against the FY2014 annual report's own comparative column for the identical period (1 Jan-31 Mar 2013): all balance-sheet and P&L figures match exactly. nav_per_share for this quarter is taken from the FY2014 report's comparative column rather than FY2013's own table, because FY2013's own table has a column-transposition defect in its NAV-per-share row only: the 1st-quarter and 3rd-quarter columns are swapped relative to every other row in the same table. This was caught by recomputing NAV from this table's own equity and paid-up-capital rows (equity ÷ (paid-up-capital/BDT10 par) = NAV): the printed Q1 value of 22.26 is arithmetically this table's own Q3 figure (equity 18,624.01/836.612m shares = 22.26), and the printed Q3 value of 20.32 is this table's own Q1 figure (equity 17,000.04/836.612m shares = 20.32) -- so the two have been swapped in the source PDF's or its extraction's cell layout. The FY2014 report's comparative column confirms the corrected values exactly for all three of Q1/Q2/Q3-2013 (20.32/21.70/22.26), and this same recomputation method (verified against FY2013's own already-recorded annual NAV of 24.51) is used as the basis. No NOCFPS row exists in the FY2013 table (introduced only from the FY2014 report onward), so it is omitted here rather than fabricated.
